title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Shorthills AI is an end\-to\-end Generative AI and Data Engineering Solution Provider. Based out of Shorthills (NJ, USA) and New Delhi (India) we build Generative AI tools and products for enterprises. We work closely with our clients from Data Pre\-processing to Data Pipelines in Data Lakes to Machine Learning and AI. Our Services include Data Engineering, Prompt Engineering, Model Selection, MLOps and Finetuning. An ISO 27001:2022 Certified company, Shorthills AI is also a Gold Partner with Microsoft. With a team of 350\+, featuring over the biggest region, we are a group of ambitious and talented people from different corners of India. Fostering a truly open and progressive culture, combined with state\-of\-the\-art engineering and creative approaches to marketing — working at Shorthills AI is a powerful mix of purpose, challenge and most of all fun.

To Know more about the organization, please visit the below links:

Our Company website: http://www.shorthills.ai

LinkedIn Page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/shorthills\-ai/

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist** with **5\+ years of experience in IT recruitment**. This role focuses on managing end\-to\-end hiring, sourcing strong technical talent, partnering with hiring managers, and ensuring timely closure of positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to onboarding.
* Source candidates through **Naukri, LinkedIn, referrals, and other channels**.
* Recruit for technical roles including **Software Developers, Data Engineers, AI/ML, Cloud, DevOps, and Full Stack Developers**.
* Understand technical requirements and create effective sourcing strategies.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and coordinate interviews.
* Manage candidate communication, offer negotiations, and follow\-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, pipelines, and hiring reports.
* Work closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to achieve hiring targets.
* Build and maintain a strong technical talent pipeline.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of experience in IT Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.**
* Strong experience in **end\-to\-end IT hiring**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Naukri, LinkedIn, Boolean search, and other sourcing platforms**.
* Experience hiring across multiple technical skill sets.
* Strong candidate screening and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of IT technologies and technical job descriptions.
* Experience with ATS / recruitment tools is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA in Human Resources / HR Management or equivalent.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and negotiation abilities.
* Good time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple requirements.
* Strong ownership and problem\-solving skills.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
